segments.text: Creta Electric just got another price hike in June 2026, and the range now runs ₹18.03 to ₹24.70 lakh. Hyundai clearly assumes your society already has three.
On paper the petrol Creta looks tame: ₹10.91 lakh to ₹20.11 lakh, twenty-seven variants, three engines. Choose Your Own Adventure — every ending is a beige-metallic school pickup.
Autocar says the all-new Creta lands late 2026, growing from 4.3 to nearly 4.5 metres, finally hybrid. Translation: the current one is already an outgoing model. Your neighbour still hasn't noticed.
My pick: the S(O) 1.5 Petrol at around ₹12.06 lakh — wireless charging, ventilated seats, a 10.25-inch screen, six airbags. Everything above just adds beige leather.
The Creta is the paneer butter masala of Indian SUVs. Every family agrees on it. Nobody can tell you which one they had last.
Take the current Creta or hold out for the all-new one? Tell me below. Subscribe — Nexon's revenge is next.
